landing.headline: Watch conflict reshape the global economy
landing.description: Select any nation. Choose a crisis scenario. Watch economic shockwaves propagate across borders in real time, backed by deterministic models and live intelligence signals.
landing.feature_signals_desc: Observed data streams merge with scenario models to surface risk before it hits headlines.
landing.feature_engine_desc: Impacts radiate through trade corridors, alliances, and commodity networks with visual arcs.
landing.feature_briefs_desc: Auto-generated briefings translate complex scenarios into actionable intelligence.
landing.living_map_desc: The globe is the operating surface. Controls, signals, and replay tools orbit around the planet.

intelligence.description: Real-time CII scoring, cross-stream correlations, and anomaly detection across monitored nations.

briefings.title: Briefings & exposure
briefings.headline: Decision support center
briefings.description: Generate structured decision briefings, analyze portfolio exposure, and manage your watchlist.

compare.headline: Compare scenarios before you decide
compare.description: This workspace ranks competing scenarios by severity, impact shape, and evidence coverage.
compare.empty_desc: Use "Add to compare" from the simulator, replay page, or account history to build a decision-ready comparison set.

paywall.headline: Keep the war room live
paywall.description: Guests get 3 lifetime simulations. Free accounts get 3 daily. Pro removes all limits.

watchlist.title: Analyst watchlist
watchlist.subtitle: Persist the geopolitical hotspots you expect to revisit.
watchlist.empty: Save countries and scenario lenses from the simulator to build your reusable watchlist.
